captions.story: The loudest sound ever recorded underwater wasn't a leviathan. The truth behind 'The Bloop' is even colder.

story.series: What Was the Loudest Sound in Ocean History?
story.summary: This episode explores the mystery of 'The Bloop', an ultra-low frequency sound detected in the Pacific in 1997. After years of speculation about giant sea monsters, scientists proved it was an icequake caused by shattering Antarctic glaciers.

title: What Was the Loudest Sound in Ocean History?
